# Help if you're struggling to pay

If you are finding it hard to pay your bill, contact us as early as you can. We can work with you
on options that suit your situation.

## What we can offer

- A payment plan that spreads what you owe over smaller, regular payments.
- More time to pay a bill.
- A hardship program with extra support while things are difficult.
- Checking that you are on the plan that best suits you.

## Free financial counselling

Free, independent financial counselling is available through the National Debt Helpline.
